request.state:
Icelandic original: „Á toppinum á hvanadalshnúk er hæsti púntur landsins og er með því glæsinlega útsýni yfir allt sem við ístlendingar höfum gert“
English gloss: “At the top of Hvannadalshnúkur is the highest point in the country and offers such a beautiful view over everything we Icelanders have done.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
